chunks.text: You guys tied nine to nine... so the wheel decided.
So I took my dusty ball to the street pitch. First touch... it rolled straight into the fence. These kids were cooking me.
One of them looked at me and said, "Bro... you're like a fifteen overall."
Fifteen. Speed, fifteen. Shooting, twelve. Passing, eighteen. Dribbling, fourteen. Defense, sixteen. Physical, fifteen.
If I wanna go pro, that number has to climb. So you pick what I train.

chunks.title: SPEED
chunks.text: Option A: I run sprints at five a.m. and boost my speed.

chunks.title: SHOOTING
chunks.text: Option B: I take a hundred shots a day and boost my shooting.
Comment A or B. Whatever wins... that's Day three.
